## Heating Repair Request for Toronto Apartment

A polite but firm note works best here: state the issue, the timeframe, the temperature, and the fact that you have already reported it twice.

## Email Draft and Follow-Up Message

**Subject:** Urgent: Unreliable Heating in Apartment

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I’m writing again about the heating issue in my apartment. The heat has been unreliable for the past 5 days, and the indoor temperature has been around 16°C at night.

I’ve already reported this twice by text, but the problem has not been resolved. Since this is a month-to-month tenancy, I’m asking that the heating system be repaired as soon as possible and that you confirm when this will be addressed.

Please let me know today what steps will be taken and when I can expect the issue to be fixed.

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Apartment Address]
[Phone Number]

### Follow-Up After 48 Hours

Hi [Landlord’s Name],

I’m following up on my earlier messages about the heating issue in my apartment. The heat is still unreliable, and the temperature remains around 16°C at night.

As I mentioned, I have already reported this twice by text and have not yet received a response. Please confirm by today when the repair will be completed.

Thank you,
[Your Name]

## Quick Actions

- Action: [Button: Copy email] https://www.canada.ca/en/financial-consumer-agency/services/renting-first-apartment/tenant-rights.html
